title: Inter's Pio Esposito scored twice as Italy beat France 3–1
caption: Inter's Pio Esposito scored twice as Italy beat France 3–1 at San Siro — his first double for Italy, per Inter.it and the FIGC. Inter have published nine matches to Christmas, ending with the Supercoppa against Lazio.
